questions.q: For grab bars, the best material is:
questions.n: It's strong, corrosion-free and cleanable.

questions.q: Which fixtures may feed a graywater system?
questions.n: Graywater excludes toilet (black) and hazardous wastes.

questions.q: Which shower setup leaves the fewest parts showing?
questions.n: The valve body hides in the wall.

questions.q: The first washerless faucet design was the:
questions.n: Ball faucets did away with rubber washers.

questions.q: Three floors, three apartments per floor, each T&B with WC, lavatory, floor drain, shower head and shower drain. How many separate P-traps?
questions.n: Lavatory, floor drain and shower drain need traps (the WC has its own built in): 3 × 9 units = 27.

questions.q: A sluice valve is essentially a:
questions.n: Both lift a gate out of the flow.

questions.q: A low-rise will later grow into a mid-rise whose roof is taken up by mechanical equipment, with no floor able to carry a tank. Which water system?
questions.n: With no tank space, pumps must push water up.

questions.q: The typical inlet and outlet size of a one-way angle valve under a lavatory is:
questions.n: Supply stops are 1/2".

questions.q: A foot valve at the end of a pump suction line is a kind of:
questions.n: It keeps the suction line primed.

questions.q: Which water heater has no storage tank?
questions.n: Point-of-use units heat water on demand.

questions.q: How many pints are in 13 US gallons?
questions.n: 8 pints per gallon × 13 = 104.

questions.q: Which goes in during plumbing rough-in?
questions.n: Rough-in is concealed piping; fixtures come at finishing.

questions.q: Tough, corrosion-proof pipe used for dewatering and dredging and laid by trenchless methods:
questions.n: HDPE is flexible and fusion-welded.

questions.q: Reversing the flow through a pool filter to flush out trapped dirt is:
questions.n: Backwash cleans sand and DE filters.

questions.q: For a household with small children and elderly users, which bathtub is safest?
questions.n: Inset tubs have a lower rim and grab surfaces around them.

questions.q: A concealed (in-wall) cistern pairs with a:
questions.n: The cistern frame also carries the hung bowl.

questions.q: A floor-outlet water closet has a built-in trap that works like a:
questions.n: Floor outlets drop straight down, S-pattern.

questions.q: For a tight bathroom, the space-saving lavatory is the:
questions.n: Corner basins tuck into unused corners.

questions.q: Copper tube can be joined without heat using a:
questions.n: A ferrule squeezes onto the tube.

questions.q: For a vintage look, choose fixtures in:
questions.n: Brass and bronze read as traditional.

questions.q: Most expensive bathtub material in this list:
questions.n: Enameled cast iron tubs cost the most; fiberglass is the budget end.

questions.q: Cheapest bathtub on the market:
questions.n: Fiberglass tubs are molded and inexpensive.

questions.q: The faucet part that covers the gap between the faucet base and the sink is the:
questions.n: A deck plate (escutcheon) hides the extra holes.

questions.q: With 50 psi at the base and 15 psi needed at the top fixture, at about 10 ft per storey, roughly how many storeys can be served?
questions.n: 35 psi ÷ 0.433 psi/ft ≈ 81 ft, which is about 8 storeys.

questions.q: A heavily used commercial pool skims best with a:
questions.n: Overflow gutters handle large bather loads.

questions.q: Reinforced concrete drainage pipes are usually supplied in lengths of:
questions.n: Local RCP comes in 1-meter sections.

questions.q: A rubber gasket with a band clamp joins:
questions.n: No-hub couplings seal with neoprene gaskets.

questions.q: Which pipe is normally joined by threading?
questions.n: GI pipe is threaded; HDPE is fused, copper soldered and CPVC solvent-welded.

questions.q: The most common "special construction" item in houses is the:
questions.n: Pools fall under Division 13.

questions.q: Water use of a typical single-flush close-coupled WC:
questions.n: 6 LPF is the common low-flush standard.

questions.q: An air admittance valve is most useful for venting the sink in a(n):
questions.n: An island sink has no nearby wall to carry a vent stack.

questions.q: Where does the plumbing code expect cleanouts?
o: Midway along short runs under 3 m
At the base of each waste stack and at changes of direction greater than 45°
questions.n: Cleanouts must be accessible where blockages collect.
